provenance.source: English for Everyone Junior: Beginner’s Course, First American Edition (2020)
provenance.method: Original practice adapted to the learning objectives of the supplied book; no page scans or recordings distributed.

planningRule: 26 book milestones, about 27 calendar weeks including the extra pilot consolidation. Extend rather than compress if recall or motivation is weak. Only book units 1–3 are authored in the app. Later objectives are topic-level proposals, not a verified grammar mapping.

milestones.title: My friends
milestones.outcome: Greet someone; introduce yourself; ask name, age and how they are; understand 1–10.

milestones.title: At school
milestones.outcome: Recognise classroom objects and simple instructions; ask and tell his/her name.

milestones.title: Our classroom
milestones.outcome: Invite an activity with Let’s; understand 11–20; use regular plurals with known objects.

milestones.title: My things
milestones.outcome: Name personal belongings and identify them in short exchanges.

milestones.title: Our favorite animals
milestones.outcome: Name familiar animals and describe simple distinguishing features.

milestones.title: This is my family
milestones.outcome: Introduce family members and describe who is in a family picture.

milestones.title: This is my room
milestones.outcome: Name room objects and describe a simple scene with support.

milestones.title: Review: This is me
milestones.outcome: Combine introductions, family and familiar possessions in a personal mini-presentation.

milestones.title: At the fair
milestones.outcome: Use familiar language in a fairground scene, including simple questions and responses.

milestones.title: Our pets
milestones.outcome: Talk about pets and notice relevant similarities and differences.

milestones.title: My body
milestones.outcome: Name body parts and follow simple actions or descriptions.

milestones.title: Our town
milestones.outcome: Identify familiar places in a town and talk about a simple map.

milestones.title: My home
milestones.outcome: Name rooms and familiar things at home; describe a home scene.

milestones.title: Review: Where I live
milestones.outcome: Use town and home vocabulary in a short personal description and conversation.

milestones.title: On the farm
milestones.outcome: Name farm animals and objects; understand and describe a farm scene.

milestones.title: Sports
milestones.outcome: Talk about sports and participate in a short exchange connected to soccer.

milestones.title: At the food market
milestones.outcome: Name foods and practise a simple food-market exchange.

milestones.title: At the toy store
milestones.outcome: Name toys and use language in a pretend shop or collection activity.

milestones.title: Our hobbies
milestones.outcome: Talk about hobbies, making room for Minecraft and maths with reviewed language.

milestones.title: Review: What I like
milestones.outcome: Combine sports, food, toys and hobbies in a short account of preferences.

milestones.title: Our party clothes
milestones.outcome: Name clothes and describe what people are wearing in a supported scene.

milestones.title: Our day at the beach
milestones.outcome: Use beach vocabulary and describe or respond to a familiar holiday scene.

milestones.title: Lunchtime
milestones.outcome: Use food and mealtime language in a short practical interaction.

milestones.title: At the park
milestones.outcome: Talk about activities in a park using vocabulary and structures confirmed in the unit.

milestones.title: My day
milestones.outcome: Describe a simple daily routine and connect familiar activities.

milestones.title: Review: Me and my day
milestones.outcome: Create a final personal account and revisit gaps across the course, including an oral check.
